scope: Existing automated public-surface criteria, including an HTML source sweep; not six fresh agents, real mobile interaction, full recursive broken-link coverage or paid purchase verification.
limitations: The collector emits its report only after all reads finish; it has no per-request deadline or retained raw request transcript. A long-running call cannot be attributed from this output alone.
Criteria that pass over reachable HTML are not proof that every sitemap URL answered; the report does not retain a per-URL status inventory.
